note: Conceptual/architecture lesson on API Enabled, API Only User, OAuth scope, and TLS enforcement as the core API security controls, with a redesign-scenario Lab instead of a UI walkthrough, per this course's conceptual/architecture policy. The 'API inherits the logged-in user's access' and TLS/cipher-strength claims were verified directly against Salesforce's own API security concepts documentation before being stated; OAuth scope behavior is described at a conceptual level (narrows, never widens access) rather than citing a specific scope name, since exact scope names/behavior can vary by API version and weren't independently confirmed this session.
